Container.Name: moviebrain
Container.Overview: Shows trivia from IMDb and Wikipedia for the movie or TV episode currently playing on Plex or Jellyfin. Set up your servers and optional sign-in (Plex or Pocket ID) from the Settings page in the web UI.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Optional - can also be set in the web UI. e.g. http://0.0.0.0:32400

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Optional - can also be set in the web UI

Config.Name: Jellyfin URL
Config.Description: Optional - can also be set in the web UI. e.g. http://0.0.0.0:8096

Config.Name: Jellyfin API Key
Config.Description: Optional - can also be set in the web UI

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns the config folder (99 = nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that owns the config folder (100 = users)

Config.Name: Disable sign-in (recovery)
Config.Description: Set to true if you lock yourself out; sign-in is skipped until you set it back to false
